parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-03 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 177.8 | 13.27 | 13.27
2 | 265.8 | 3.40 | 16.67
3 | 1064.5 | 8.81 | 25.48
4 | 2584.7 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-03
Curve type: AA
Aquifer depth: 0 – 13.3 m (shallow weathered zone)
Recommendation: High resistivities at depth indicate tight, fresh crystalline bedrock below 16.7 m with poor deep groundwater prospects. Drilling beyond ~20–25 m is not advised, and development should target the shallow weathered overburden or relocate to an area with deeper fracturing.
